sentences.text: 3. This Court vide order dated 29.08.2025, after taking note of the fact that the instant revision relates to enlargement of revisionist on bail, directed the Senior Registrar of this Court to provide the status of the present case.

4. Today, learned A.G.A. has produced before this Court the copy of the letter sent by Inspector,
Police Station - Kudwar, District-Sultanpur addressed to the Government Advocate, High Court,
Lucknow annexing therewith the copy of the judgment dated 09.08.2021, which is taken on record.

A perusal of the judgment dated 09.08.2021 annexed with the letter dated 30.08.2025, passed in Special Sessions Trial No. 355 of 2018 (State Vs. Ansar S/o Mukhtar Ahmad and Monu @ Jahid Husain S/o Mohammad Husain) indicates that the revisionist has been convicted for the offence under Section 376-D and has been sentenced to under Rigorous Imprisonment for 20 years.
